name: Bring Back the Mug
summary: After delivering a piping hot draught of Mornbrew across the snowdrifts of Dun Morogh, one final errand remains: returning the empty tankard. Durnan Furcutter sends the runner back across Coldridge Valley to return Nori Pridedrift's prized mug. It is a simple courtesy, but one the brew seller deeply appreciates.

sections.title: A Matter of Tavern Etiquette
sections.body: Serving piping hot Mornbrew out in the biting freeze of Dun Morogh is a delicate business. Once Durnan Furcutter has finished warming his bones with the scalding brew, the empty tankard cannot simply be tossed in the snow. Dwarven hospitality runs on mutual respect, and letting good dishware go missing is a sure way to find oneself cut off from future rounds.

sections.title: Mugs Don't Grow on Trees
sections.body: Returning to Coldridge Valley completes the delivery run for Nori Pridedrift. As Nori is fond of reminding forgetful couriers, sturdy drinkware does not simply grow on trees—especially not in the subzero crags of the dwarven homeland. Returning the empty vessel in one piece cements an adventurer's reputation as a reliable hand in the local community.

aliases: who gives bring back the mug
faq.answer: Durnan Furcutter gives you this task immediately after you deliver the freshly brewed Mornbrew to him out in Dun Morogh.

faq.q: Who do I return the mug to?
aliases: where do i take the mug
faq.answer: You return the empty mug to Nori Pridedrift, who wanders Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh selling his mornbrew.

faq.q: Is there a time limit to return the mug?
aliases: do i have to hurry back
faq.answer: No. While the initial delivery of the Scalding Mornbrew had a strict timer to keep the drink piping hot, returning the empty mug can be done at your own pace.

faq.q: Why does Nori care so much about an empty mug?
aliases: why does nori want the mug back
faq.answer: Quality mugs and steins are valuable barware in Dun Morogh. As Nori points out, mugs do not grow on trees, and taverns cannot afford to lose drinkware to every passing courier.

faq.q: What quest leads directly into this one?
aliases: what comes before bring back the mug
faq.answer: This errand is the direct follow-up to 'Scalding Mornbrew Delivery', beginning the moment Durnan drinks the beverage you brought him.

faq.q: Where can Durnan Furcutter be found?
faq.answer: Durnan Furcutter is a cloth and leather armor merchant found inside Anvilmar, the settlement dug into the mountain in Coldridge Valley.

angles.text: Every dwarf knows that keeping a tavernkeeper's tankard is a quick route to a brawl; returning Nori's mug is basic dwarven manners.
Any proper cook or brewer knows that quality service does not end until the dishware is accounted for and returned to the kitchen.
